latest_cos_commentary.headline: 3Owl is a digital experience agency helping multi-unit restaurant brands unify websites, apps, and ordering, not a POS/payments platform itself.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes indirectly on digital_menu_boards/loyalty_engagement by building the guest-facing ordering layer restaurants use atop platforms like Olo; does not compete on core pos or payments.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: September 2026 EveryBite partnership signals a push into AI-driven menu personalization as a differentiator.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Understand 3Owl operates one layer up from POS as an agency/integrator; ask which POS and ordering platforms a client's 3Owl build sits on top of.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No leadership, financial, or named enterprise-customer data was verifiable; do not assume scale beyond what is sourced.
